svg.title: Sheet 5 of 6, detail D, business systems, with a test-runner strip turning green: ANF System for the Adoración Nocturna Filipina National Council. 4,000+ automated checks (4,170, all passing, on September 12, 2026), 20+ screens, 140+ decision records.
